info.title: API.SH: XING
info.description: The XING API from API.SH: public XING data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company's XING page: name, slogan, link, logo and cover image, followers, members on XING, company size, industry id, about text, locations (address, postcode, city, country, coordinates, business phone, fax, email, website, headquarters flag), up to 12 open jobs (title, link, locations, refreshed and active-until dates, salary when shown), related companies and the latest posts (date, text, image, likes, comments).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xing-company

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The company's page name (the part after xing.com/pages/, e.g. `sap`, `siemensag`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Employee, applicant or apprentice reviews of a company from kununu, XING's employer review site (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), 10 a page: title, overall score, recommendation, former-employee flag, position, department, publish and update dates, per-category ratings with comments, texts, location, employer responses and helpful/agree counts; plus the company's score, applicant score, recommendation rate, verified flag, top-company years, headquarters, review totals, score ranges and summary. Logged out, kununu shows the first page (10 reviews) of each review type and sort, so `next_page` is null: use `type` and `sort` (newest, oldest, best, worst, helpful) to read different reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xing-company-reviews

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company's kununu name (sap, bosch, deutsche-bahn) or a kununu.com/<country>/<company> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on XING (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) for keywords and/or location, with radius, employment type, career level, remote, minimum salary, industry, discipline and company filters: id, title, link, company, company id and logo, location(s), employment type, salary (XING's estimate when the ad has none: currency, min, max, median), refresh and expiry dates, top-job flag, a short summary (introduction, responsibilities, qualifications) and the apply link. 20 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xing-search

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: Fully remote, partly remote or on-site jobs (fully remote jobs are not limited to `location`).

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry id, e.g. 41200.039daf (`industry_id` of a job).

parameters.name: discipline
parameters.description: Discipline id, e.g. 1010.b48650 (`discipline_id` of a job).

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company id, e.g. 2019285.00e581 (`company_id` of a job).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-50). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
